bind-pdf-form-to-autofiller.title: Fill PDF Form Fields Using Aspose.Pdf
bind-pdf-form-to-autofiller.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate specific form fields (text box and checkbox), set their values, and save the updated document.

load-csv-to-datatable-formdata-converter.title: Create Sample DataTable and Illustrate PdfConverter Usage
load-csv-to-datatable-formdata-converter.description: Shows how to build a DataTable with sample data and includes a placeholder demonstrating the use of Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter for PDF conversion when a source PDF is available.

import-datatable-into-pdf-form-with-read.title: Import DataTable with Column Constraints into PDF Form
import-datatable-into-pdf-form-with-read.description: Shows how to configure DataColumn properties such as ReadOnly and Unique before importing a DataTable into a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf's AutoFiller.

fill-pdf-form-using-autofiller-datatable.title: Fill PDF AcroForm Using AutoFiller and DataTable
fill-pdf-form-using-autofiller-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to populate a DataTable and import it into Aspose.Pdf's AutoFiller to automatically map column values to matching AcroForm fields in a PDF.

fill-pdf-form-field-preserve-layout.title: Fill PDF Form and Preserve Layout
fill-pdf-form-field-preserve-layout.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, fill its form fields using the Form facade, and save the updated document while keeping the original layout intact.

pdf-one-page-per-datarow.title: Create PDF with One Page per DataTable Row
pdf-one-page-per-datarow.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF where each row of a DataTable is placed on its own page and verifies that the page count matches the number of rows.

map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-form-fields.title: Map DataTable Columns to PDF Form Fields and Fill PDF
map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to align DataTable column names with PDF form field identifiers and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller to populate the PDF.

fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller.title: Fill PDF Form from CSV using AutoFiller and DataTable
fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller.description: Demonstrates mapping CSV data to PDF form fields by creating a DataTable with column names matching the PDF fields and importing it with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller.

fill-pdf-form-from-multiple-csv-workshee.title: Fill PDF Form from Multiple DataTables (One per Sheet)
fill-pdf-form-from-multiple-csv-workshee.description: Shows how to load a PDF template, iterate over several in‑memory DataTable objects that represent separate worksheets, fill the corresponding form fields for each sheet, and save a distinct filled PDF file.

fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller-exception-.title: Fill PDF Form Fields with Error Handling
fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller-exception-.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, populating its form fields from an XML data source, and using comprehensive exception handling for missing files and form‑field errors.

fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller__v2.title: Fill PDF Form Fields and Save with Aspose.Pdf
fill-pdf-form-with-autofiller__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating text box form fields, assigning values, and saving the filled document while ensuring resources are released.

batch-fill-pdf-template-with-multiple-da.title: Batch Fill PDF Form Using Multiple DataTables
batch-fill-pdf-template-with-multiple-da.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form template and populating its fields with data from a list of DataTable objects, producing a separate filled PDF for each data set.

fill-pdf-form-from-memory-stream.title: Fill PDF Form from Memory Stream Using AutoFiller
fill-pdf-form-from-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF into a MemoryStream, binding it to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller, importing data from a DataTable, and saving the filled form back to a MemoryStream without creating intermediate files.

extract-pdf-pages-with-custom-names.title: Generate Separate PDFs with Custom Names from DataTable Rows
extract-pdf-pages-with-custom-names.description: Demonstrates creating a combined PDF where each DataTable row adds a page with its value as text, then extracting each page into an individual PDF file named after that column value.

log-datatable-row-processing-pdf-page-cr.title: Log Row Processing and Create PDF Pages per DataTable Row
log-datatable-row-processing-pdf-page-cr.description: The example iterates through a DataTable, creates a separate PDF page for each row using Aspose.Pdf, and logs the row index along with the generated page number to a log file.

apply-password-protection-to-filled-pdf.title: Apply Password Protection to a Filled PDF
apply-password-protection-to-filled-pdf.description: Fills a form field in an existing PDF and then encrypts the document with user and owner passwords, saving a password‑protected PDF.

merge-filled-pdfs-from-datatables.title: Merge Multiple PDFs into a Single Document
merge-filled-pdfs-from-datatables.description: Demonstrates how to combine several PDF files generated from DataTables into one consolidated PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and page collection handling.

convert-in-memory-pdf-to-byte-array.title: Convert Filled PDF to Byte Array
convert-in-memory-pdf-to-byte-array.description: Loads a filled PDF using Aspose.Pdf and saves it directly to a MemoryStream, returning the PDF content as a byte array for transmission without writing to disk.

async-fill-pdf-form-from-data-table.title: Asynchronously Fill PDF Form from Excel Data
async-fill-pdf-form-from-data-table.description: Demonstrates loading field values from an XLSX file using asynchronous I/O, filling an Aspose.PDF form, and saving the result asynchronously to improve performance.

validate-filled-pdf-fields-against-datat.title: Validate Filled PDF Form Fields Against DataTable
validate-filled-pdf-fields-against-datat.description: Fills a PDF form using data from a DataTable, then reads the filled PDF to verify each field matches the original values.

retry-autofiller-import-transient-errors.title: Import PDF Form Data with Retry Logic for Transient Errors
retry-autofiller-import-transient-errors.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's AutoFiller to bind a PDF, import data from an XML‑derived DataTable, and save the filled document while handling transient I/O exceptions with a retry mechanism.

pdf-page-identifier-summary-report.title: Generate Summary Report Mapping PDF Pages to Identifiers
pdf-page-identifier-summary-report.description: Demonstrates how to read a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to obtain the page count, load a CSV into a DataTable, match each page number to an identifier, and write a summary CSV report.

add-date-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Current Date Header to Filled PDF Form
add-date-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to fill a PDF form with XML data using the Form facade and then add a header containing the current date to each page of the resulting document.

fill-pdf-form-from-csv-with-mapping.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from CSV Using a JSON Mapping
fill-pdf-form-from-csv-with-mapping.description: Demonstrates how to read data from a CSV file, map column names to PDF form fields via a JSON configuration, and fill an Aspose.Pdf template for each row.

batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-large-csv.title: Generate PDFs from Large CSV Using AutoFiller
batch-fill-pdf-forms-from-large-csv.description: Demonstrates streaming a CSV file row‑by‑row, creating a one‑row DataTable for each record, and using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller to fill a PDF form and save the result, avoiding high memory consumption.

fill-pdf-form-verify-size.title: Fill PDF Form from DataTable and Validate File Size
fill-pdf-form-verify-size.description: Demonstrates filling a PDF form using a DataTable, optionally appending pages from another PDF, and checking that the final PDF does not exceed a predefined size limit.

fill-pdf-form-from-csv-xlsx.title: Fill PDF Form Using Aspose AutoFiller
fill-pdf-form-from-csv-xlsx.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller to bind a PDF template, import data from a DataTable, and save the filled PDF.

fill-pdf-form-with-timeout.title: Fill PDF Form with Cancellation Token and Timeout
fill-pdf-form-with-timeout.description: Demonstrates how to populate form fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and abort the operation if it exceeds a specified timeout by employing a CancellationToken.

convert-large-pdf-to-excel-with-temp-fol.title: Convert Large Excel to PDF with Temporary Folder
convert-large-pdf-to-excel-with-temp-fol.description: Shows how to split a large Excel workbook into intermediate PDF files stored in a temporary folder and then concatenate them into a final PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

format-numeric-datatable-values-fill-pdf.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from DataTable with Numeric Formatting
format-numeric-datatable-values-fill-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF template, format numeric and date values from a DataTable, and fill matching form fields using Aspose.Pdf.

split-filled-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.title: Export Filled PDF Pages as Separate Single‑Page PDFs
split-filled-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.description: Shows how to split a filled PDF document into individual one‑page PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

fill-pdf-form-from-csv.title: Fill PDF Form from CSV using Aspose AutoFiller
fill-pdf-form-from-csv.description: Shows how to read CSV data into a DataTable and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller to bind a PDF template, import the data, and save the filled PDF.

export-filtered-datatable-to-pdf-merge-t.title: Export Filtered DataTable to PDF and Merge with Template
export-filtered-datatable-to-pdf-merge-t.description: Creates a DataTable, filters rows, builds a PDF table from the filtered data, and optionally merges the result with a template PDF.

validate-required-pdf-form-fields__v2.title: Validate Required PDF Form Fields Against DataTable
validate-required-pdf-form-fields__v2.description: Demonstrates how to ensure every required form field in a PDF has a matching column in a DataTable before importing data, throwing an exception for any missing columns.

add-watermark-to-pdf-after-form-filling.title: Add Watermark to PDF After Form Filling
add-watermark-to-pdf-after-form-filling.description: Shows how to load a PDF that has been populated by AutoFiller, create a semi‑transparent text stamp, and apply it as a watermark on each page.
